key_insight: Semantic watermarking can preserve a generator’s output distribution when averaged over secret detection keys while supporting detection after content-preserving transformations.
engineering_relevance: The approach enables watermarking of open-source and closed generative models using only sampling access and semantic-embedding queries, without model internals.
method: Construct a provably distortion-free watermark using black-box generator samples and semantic-embedding queries.
Train an image encoder to balance transformation stability with separation of independent generations from the same prompt.
Use semantic representations for watermark detection robust to content-preserving image changes.
evidence_signal: Image experiments on open-source and closed models report improved encoder separation over off-the-shelf alternatives, maintained stability, and strong aggregate detection under various transformations.
watch_item: Robustness depends on the embedding’s stability–separation tradeoff; the abstract does not quantify detection performance for individual outputs.
paper_title: Distortion-Free Semantic Watermarks for Black-Box Generative Models
